The '''Iktotch system''', also known as the '''Iktotchon system''', included the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Iktotchon/Legends|Iktotchon]] and the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Iktotch/Legends|Iktotch]], which was the home to the [[Iktotchi/Legends|Iktotchi]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. With many plants, it had an environment powerful enough to withstand a fire.
